places.name: Alex Restaurant
places.evidence: Founded by Alexandru (Măcelarul) & wife Mariana, grew from his 1997 butcher shop; team page states he is hands-on, 'Alex Restaurant is about people and with people'

places.name: Hugo by Alex
places.evidence: Chef Alexandru Manole returned from Spain to open this as personal project; designed venue with wife Ana Maria Manole; cooks dishes using family farm produce (Revista Urbania profile)

places.name: Grill House by Alex
places.evidence: Part of Alexandru's owner-operated Alex brand (shared website restaurantalex.ro with Alex Restaurant and Măcelăria Alex); same hands-on founder

places.name: Stage Nice Dining
places.evidence: Founded ~2015 by Ana Savin; Playtech interview confirms she personally trains staff, monitors weekend service, runs Monday team meetings; coined and patented 'nice dining' concept

places.name: SER Coffee 2 GO
places.evidence: Founded early 2020 by Alina Gabriela Sbraci, self-described coffee enthusiast; about page presents it as personal passion project born from love of specialty coffee
